question: Should `check-workflows` expose `OPENCLAW_CHECK_WORKFLOWS_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS` as a supported configuration surface, or should this repair retain only a fixed internal timeout?
rationale: The PR adds a new environment override beyond the timeout repair; repository policy treats new environment surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and asks maintainers to confirm that an existing default cannot serve the use case.

options.title: Use a fixed timeout only
options.body: Keep the five-minute bounded behavior and remove the environment override, minimizing the public configuration surface.

options.title: Support the override explicitly
options.body: Retain the capped override, document its intended CI and local use, and add validation for invalid and capped values.

recommendation.title: Use a fixed timeout only
recommendation.body: Keep the five-minute bounded behavior and remove the environment override, minimizing the public configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author implemented the timeout policy and can revise it once a maintainer chooses the supported configuration boundary.
